verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework for building voice and multimodal agents, so background automation is a fair axis, but the evidence documents no scheduled, recurring, or autonomous background automation feature. Subagent handoff for long-running tools and multi-agent coordination happen inside a live conversation pipeline. Carrier webhooks that start telephony sessions are an inbound call trigger, not a user-configurable recurring automation, so neither counts as this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
